title: Cartwise Rewards Redemption Terms by Tier
content:
Cartwise Rewards points are spent in blocks: at every tier one redemption block is 1000 points and is worth $10.00, and at least 1 block must be redeemed on an order that uses points. What changes from tier to tier is how much of an order points may pay and whether points may pay fees.

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Points per block | Value of one block | Fewest blocks on one order | Most of the order's item subtotal points may pay | Points may pay delivery and service fees |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Member | 1000 | $10.00 | 1 | 50% | No |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | 1000 | $10.00 | 1 | 50% | No |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver | 1000 | $10.00 | 1 | 50% | No |
| Cartwise Rewards Gold | 1000 | $10.00 | 1 | 60% | No |
| Cartwise Rewards Platinum | 1000 | $10.00 | 1 | 75% | Yes |
| Cartwise Rewards Diamond | 1000 | $10.00 | 1 | 100% | Yes |

## Terms the same at every tier

| Term | Setting at every tier |
|---|---|
| Points apply after Cartwise+ credit on the same order | Yes |
| Points redeemed on an order canceled before shopping come back | Yes |
| Points may pay alcohol lines | No |

## Notes

- Only Cartwise Rewards Platinum and Cartwise Rewards Diamond allow points to pay delivery and service fees; at Member, Bronze, Silver and Gold they may not.
- No tier allows points to pay alcohol lines.
- The percentage limit is measured against the order's item subtotal.

## Hypothetical limits compared

On a hypothetical order with an item subtotal of $120.00, the most points may pay is 50% of $120.00, that is $60.00, at Member, Bronze and Silver; 60%, that is $72.00, at Gold; 75%, that is $90.00, at Platinum; and 100%, that is $120.00, at Diamond. Because points go in whole blocks of $10.00, those percentage limits on their own allow at most 6, 7, 9 and 12 blocks respectively (6000, 7000, 9000 and 12000 points).
